verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API extensively (woocommerce-docs-11, -27, -44, -x1, -x2) but a direct probe for machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger specs at expected paths returned 404 across all candidates (woocommerce-probe-2), and no evidence pack item links to a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON/YAML file. The REST API docs site appears to be human-readable documentation, not a published machine-readable spec.
